verdict.rationale: Moneybird publishes llms.txt files on both its marketing site and its developer site. The developer one was probed live (HTTP 200) and is titled "Documentation files for Large Language Models"; the marketing one points agents to MCP, CLI, API and webhook docs. missing for 10: per-page markdown doc versions (the .md probe returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agents using these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote:
PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.moneybird.com/llms.txt # Moneybird API Documentation

> Documentation files for Large Language Models
Three channels on the same REST API: MCP for an AI chat, the CLI for the terminal, the API for your own software.
[Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://developer.moneybird.com/tools/mcp): connect to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or any MCP client.
